Thread: Payment Service latency improvements

[2026-05-15 10:00 UTC] Alice Menon: After INC-17 I reviewed the slow-query logs. The majority of burst-window reads are idempotency key lookups and payment config fetches — both are read-heavy and change infrequently. We should cache them.

[2026-05-15 10:12 UTC] Ravi Nair: Agreed. I ran a local benchmark with Redis sitting in front of Postgres for those paths. p99 dropped from 380ms to 45ms at 500 concurrent requests. Cache-hit ratio was 87% with a 60-second TTL.

[2026-05-16 09:30 UTC] Maya Joseph: From a platform perspective Redis is already in our infrastructure stack for session management. We can reuse the existing cluster — no new provisioning needed.

[2026-05-17 14:00 UTC] Alice Menon: Let's go ahead. I'll write up ADR-7 and Ravi can start the implementation against PAY-42. We'll target a 60-second TTL with explicit invalidation on config writes.
